verses.original: Τεκνία μου ταῦτα γράφω ὑμῖν ἵνα μὴ ἁμάρτητε καὶ ἐάν τις ἁμάρτῃ Παράκλητον ἔχομεν πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν δίκαιον
verses.transliteration: Teknia mou tauta graphō hymin hina mē hamartēte kai ean tis hamartē Paraklēton echomen pros ton Patera Iēsoun Christon dikaion
verses.literal: My little children I am writing these things to you so that you will not sin But if anyone does sin we have an advocate before the Father Jesus Christ the Righteous One

verses.original: καὶ αὐτὸς ἱλασμός ἐστιν περὶ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ἡμῶν οὐ περὶ τῶν ἡμετέρων δὲ μόνον ἀλλὰ καὶ περὶ ὅλου τοῦ κόσμου
verses.transliteration: kai autos hilasmos estin peri tōn hamartiōn hēmōn ou peri tōn hēmeterōn de monon alla kai peri holou tou kosmou
verses.literal: He Himself is the atoning sacrifice for our sins and not only for ours but also for the sins of the whole world

verses.original: Καὶ ἐν τούτῳ γινώσκομεν ὅτι ἐγνώκαμεν αὐτόν ἐὰν τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ τηρῶμεν
verses.transliteration: Kai en toutō ginōskomen hoti egnōkamen auton ean tas entolas autou tērōmen
verses.literal: By this we can be sure that we have come to know Him if we keep His commandments

verses.original: ὁ λέγων ὅτι Ἔγνωκα αὐτόν καὶ τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ μὴ τηρῶν ψεύστης ἐστίν καὶ ἐν τούτῳ ἡ ἀλήθεια οὐκ ἔστιν
verses.transliteration: ho legōn hoti Egnōka auton kai tas entolas autou mē tērōn pseustēs estin kai en toutō hē alētheia ouk estin
verses.literal: If anyone says I know Him but does not keep His commandments he is a liar and the truth is not in him

verses.original: ὃς δ’ ἂν τηρῇ αὐτοῦ τὸν λόγον ἀληθῶς ἐν τούτῳ ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ Θεοῦ τετελείωται Ἐν τούτῳ γινώσκομεν ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ ἐσμεν
verses.transliteration: hos d’ an tērē autou ton logon alēthōs en toutō hē agapē tou Theou teteleiōtai En toutō ginōskomen hoti en autō esmen
verses.literal: But if anyone . . . keeps His word the love of God has been truly perfected . . . in him By this we know that we are in Him

verses.original: ὁ λέγων ἐν αὐτῷ μένειν ὀφείλει καθὼς ἐκεῖνος περιεπάτησεν καὶ αὐτὸς οὕτως περιπατεῖν
verses.transliteration: ho legōn en autō menein opheilei kathōs ekeinos periepatēsen kai autos houtōs peripatein
verses.literal: Whoever claims to abide in Him must walk as . . . Jesus . . . walked

verses.original: Ἀγαπητοί οὐκ ἐντολὴν καινὴν γράφω ὑμῖν ἀλλ’ ἐντολὴν παλαιὰν ἣν εἴχετε ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς ἡ ἐντολὴ ἡ παλαιά ἐστιν ὁ λόγος ὃν ἠκούσατε
verses.transliteration: Agapētoi ouk entolēn kainēn graphō hymin all’ entolēn palaian hēn eichete ap’ archēs hē entolē hē palaia estin ho logos hon ēkousate
verses.literal: Beloved I am not writing to you a new commandment but an old one which you have had from the beginning This . . . . . . commandment is the message you have heard

verses.original: πάλιν ἐντολὴν καινὴν γράφω ὑμῖν ὅ ἐστιν ἀληθὲς ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ ἐν ὑμῖν ὅτι ἡ σκοτία παράγεται καὶ τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινὸν ἤδη φαίνει
verses.transliteration: palin entolēn kainēn graphō hymin ho estin alēthes en autō kai en hymin hoti hē skotia paragetai kai to phōs to alēthinon ēdē phainei
verses.literal: Then again I am also writing to you a new commandment which is true in Him and also in you For the darkness is fading and the true light is already shining

verses.original: Ὁ λέγων ἐν τῷ φωτὶ εἶναι καὶ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ μισῶν ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ ἐστὶν ἕως ἄρτι
verses.transliteration: Ho legōn en tō phōti einai kai ton adelphon autou misōn en tē skotia estin heōs arti
verses.literal: If anyone claims to be in the light but hates his brother he is still . . . in the darkness

verses.original: ὁ ἀγαπῶν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ φωτὶ μένει καὶ σκάνδαλον ἐν αὐτῷ οὐκ ἔστιν
verses.transliteration: ho agapōn ton adelphon autou en tō phōti menei kai skandalon en autō ouk estin
verses.literal: Whoever loves his brother remains in the light and there is no cause of stumbling in him

verses.original: ὁ δὲ μισῶν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ ἐστὶν καὶ ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ περιπατεῖ καὶ οὐκ οἶδεν ποῦ ὑπάγει ὅτι ἡ σκοτία ἐτύφλωσεν τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: ho de misōn ton adelphon autou en tē skotia estin kai en tē skotia peripatei kai ouk oiden pou hypagei hoti hē skotia etyphlōsen tous ophthalmous autou
verses.literal: But whoever hates his brother is in the darkness and walks in the darkness He does not know where he is going because the darkness has blinded his eyes

verses.original: Γράφω ὑμῖν τεκνία ὅτι ἀφέωνται ὑμῖν αἱ ἁμαρτίαι διὰ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Graphō hymin teknia hoti apheōntai hymin hai hamartiai dia to onoma autou
verses.literal: I am writing to you little children because your sins have been forgiven . . . through His name

verses.original: Γράφω ὑμῖν πατέρες ὅτι ἐγνώκατε τὸν ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς Γράφω ὑμῖν νεανίσκοι ὅτι νενικήκατε τὸν πονηρόν Ἔγραψα ὑμῖν παιδία ὅτι ἐγνώκατε τὸν Πατέρα
verses.transliteration: Graphō hymin pateres hoti egnōkate ton ap’ archēs Graphō hymin neaniskoi hoti nenikēkate ton ponēron Egrapsa hymin paidia hoti egnōkate ton Patera
verses.literal: I am writing to you fathers because you know Him who is from the beginning I am writing to you young men because you have overcome the evil one I have written to you children because you know the Father

verses.original: Ἔγραψα ὑμῖν πατέρες ὅτι ἐγνώκατε τὸν ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς Ἔγραψα ὑμῖν νεανίσκοι ὅτι ἰσχυροί ἐστε καὶ ὁ λόγος τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν ὑμῖν μένει καὶ νενικήκατε τὸν πονηρόν
verses.transliteration: Egrapsa hymin pateres hoti egnōkate ton ap’ archēs Egrapsa hymin neaniskoi hoti ischyroi este kai ho logos tou Theou en hymin menei kai nenikēkate ton ponēron
verses.literal: I have written to you fathers because you know Him who is from the beginning I have written to you young men because you are strong and the word of God abides in you and you have overcome the evil one

verses.original: Μὴ ἀγαπᾶτε τὸν κόσμον μηδὲ τὰ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ἐάν τις ἀγαπᾷ τὸν κόσμον οὐκ ἔστιν ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ Πατρὸς ἐν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Mē agapate ton kosmon mēde ta en tō kosmō ean tis agapa ton kosmon ouk estin hē agapē tou Patros en autō
verses.literal: Do not love the world or anything in the world If anyone loves the world the love of the Father is not in him

verses.original: ὅτι πᾶν τὸ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ἡ ἐπιθυμία τῆς σαρκὸς καὶ ἡ ἐπιθυμία τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν καὶ ἡ ἀλαζονεία τοῦ βίου οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τοῦ πατρός ἀλλὰ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου ἐστίν
verses.transliteration: hoti pan to en tō kosmō hē epithymia tēs sarkos kai hē epithymia tōn ophthalmōn kai hē alazoneia tou biou ouk estin ek tou patros alla ek tou kosmou estin
verses.literal: For all that is in the world the desires of the flesh the desires of the eyes and the pride of life is not from the Father but from the world

verses.original: καὶ ὁ κόσμος παράγεται καὶ ἡ ἐπιθυμία αὐτοῦ ὁ δὲ ποιῶν τὸ θέλημα τοῦ Θεοῦ μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα
verses.transliteration: kai ho kosmos paragetai kai hē epithymia autou ho de poiōn to thelēma tou Theou menei eis ton aiōna
verses.literal: The world is passing away along with its desires but whoever does the will of God remains forever

verses.original: Παιδία ἐσχάτη ὥρα ἐστίν καὶ καθὼς ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἀντίχριστος ἔρχεται καὶ νῦν ἀντίχριστοι πολλοὶ γεγόνασιν ὅθεν γινώσκομεν ὅτι ἐσχάτη ὥρα ἐστίν
verses.transliteration: Paidia eschatē hōra estin kai kathōs ēkousate hoti antichristos erchetai kai nyn antichristoi polloi gegonasin hothen ginōskomen hoti eschatē hōra estin
verses.literal: Children it is the last hour and just as you have heard that the antichrist is coming so now many antichrists have appeared This is how we know it is the last hour

verses.original: ἐξ ἡμῶν ἐξῆλθαν ἀλλ’ οὐκ ἦσαν ἐξ ἡμῶν εἰ γὰρ ἐξ ἡμῶν ἦσαν μεμενήκεισαν ἂν μεθ’ ἡμῶν ἀλλ’ ἵνα φανερωθῶσιν ὅτι οὐκ εἰσὶν πάντες ἐξ ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: ex hēmōn exēlthan all’ ouk ēsan ex hēmōn ei gar ex hēmōn ēsan memenēkeisan an meth’ hēmōn all’ hina phanerōthōsin hoti ouk eisin pantes ex hēmōn
verses.literal: They went out from us but they did not belong . . . . . . to us For if they had belonged to us they would have remained with us But their departure made it clear that none of them belonged to . . . us

verses.original: Καὶ ὑμεῖς χρῖσμα ἔχετε ἀπὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ οἴδατε πάντες
verses.transliteration: Kai hymeis chrisma echete apo tou Hagiou kai oidate pantes
verses.literal: You however have an anointing from the Holy One and all of you know the truth . . .

verses.original: οὐκ ἔγραψα ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐκ οἴδατε τὴν ἀλήθειαν ἀλλ’ ὅτι οἴδατε αὐτήν καὶ ὅτι πᾶν ψεῦδος ἐκ τῆς ἀληθείας οὐκ ἔστιν
verses.transliteration: ouk egrapsa hymin hoti ouk oidate tēn alētheian all’ hoti oidate autēn kai hoti pan pseudos ek tēs alētheias ouk estin
verses.literal: I have not written to you because you lack knowledge of the truth but because you have it and because no lie comes from the truth

verses.original: Τίς ἐστιν ὁ ψεύστης εἰ μὴ ὁ ἀρνούμενος ὅτι Ἰησοῦς οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ Χριστός οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ ἀντίχριστος ὁ ἀρνούμενος τὸν Πατέρα καὶ τὸν Υἱόν
verses.transliteration: Tis estin ho pseustēs ei mē ho arnoumenos hoti Iēsous ouk estin ho Christos houtos estin ho antichristos ho arnoumenos ton Patera kai ton Huion
verses.literal: Who is the liar if it is not . . . the one who denies that Jesus is the Christ This is the antichrist who denies the Father and the Son

verses.original: πᾶς ὁ ἀρνούμενος τὸν Υἱὸν οὐδὲ τὸν Πατέρα ἔχει ὁ ὁμολογῶν τὸν Υἱὸν καὶ τὸν Πατέρα ἔχει
verses.transliteration: pas ho arnoumenos ton Huion oude ton Patera echei ho homologōn ton Huion kai ton Patera echei
verses.literal: Whoever . . . denies the Son does not have the Father but whoever confesses the Son has the Father as well

verses.original: Ὑμεῖς ὃ ἠκούσατε ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς ἐν ὑμῖν μενέτω ἐὰν ἐν ὑμῖν μείνῃ ὃ ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς ἠκούσατε καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐν τῷ Υἱῷ καὶ ἐν τῷ Πατρὶ μενεῖτε
verses.transliteration: Hymeis ho ēkousate ap’ archēs en hymin menetō ean en hymin meinē ho ap’ archēs ēkousate kai hymeis en tō Huiō kai en tō Patri meneite
verses.literal: As for you let what you have heard from the beginning remain in you If it . . . . . . . . . does . . . . . . you will also remain in the Son and in the Father

verses.original: καὶ αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ ἐπαγγελία ἣν αὐτὸς ἐπηγγείλατο ἡμῖν τὴν ζωὴν τὴν αἰώνιον
verses.transliteration: kai hautē estin hē epangelia hēn autos epēngeilato hēmin tēn zōēn tēn aiōnion
verses.literal: And this is the promise that He Himself made to us eternal life

verses.original: Ταῦτα ἔγραψα ὑμῖν περὶ τῶν πλανώντων ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Tauta egrapsa hymin peri tōn planōntōn hymas
verses.literal: I have written these things to you about those who are trying to deceive you

verses.original: καὶ ὑμεῖς τὸ χρῖσμα ὃ ἐλάβετε ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ μένει ἐν ὑμῖν καὶ οὐ χρείαν ἔχετε ἵνα τις διδάσκῃ ὑμᾶς ἀλλ’ ὡς τὸ αὐτοῦ χρῖσμα διδάσκει ὑμᾶς περὶ πάντων καὶ ἀληθές ἐστιν καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ψεῦδος καὶ καθὼς ἐδίδαξεν ὑμᾶς μένετε ἐν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: kai hymeis to chrisma ho elabete ap’ autou menei en hymin kai ou chreian echete hina tis didaskē hymas all’ hōs to autou chrisma didaskei hymas peri pantōn kai alēthes estin kai ouk estin pseudos kai kathōs edidaxen hymas menete en autō
verses.literal: And as for you the anointing you received from Him remains in you and you do not need anyone to teach you But just as His - true and genuine anointing teaches you about all things so remain in Him as you have been taught

verses.original: Καὶ νῦν τεκνία μένετε ἐν αὐτῷ ἵνα ἐὰν φανερωθῇ σχῶμεν παρρησίαν καὶ μὴ αἰσχυνθῶμεν ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ παρουσίᾳ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai nyn teknia menete en autō hina ean phanerōthē schōmen parrēsian kai mē aischynthōmen ap’ autou en tē parousia autou
verses.literal: And now little children remain in Christ so that when He appears we may be confident and unashamed before Him at His coming

verses.original: Ἐὰν εἰδῆτε ὅτι δίκαιός ἐστιν γινώσκετε ὅτι καὶ πᾶς ὁ ποιῶν τὴν δικαιοσύνην ἐξ αὐτοῦ γεγέννηται
verses.transliteration: Ean eidēte hoti dikaios estin ginōskete hoti kai pas ho poiōn tēn dikaiosynēn ex autou gegennētai
verses.literal: If you know that He is righteous you also know . . . that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of Him
